notes: Separate: angle words (acute, straight, reflex, full, included are adjectives for 'angle', not geometry words on their own); temperature words (hot, chilly, balmy are not measurements); metric prefixes (zepto, hecto are word parts, not units); ancient greek thinkers and islamic golden age scholars (they include philosophers, historians and theologians such as Herodotus, Thucydides, al-Ghazali, Ibn Khaldun who are not scientists). Borderline but kept not separate: famous naturalists (Steve Irwin, Chris Packham, Thoreau are naturalists rather than scientists), middle eastern inventions (coffee, polo, zodiac). Parent/sub-theme overlaps removed: segment from geometry; vertex and bisector from angle words (kept in geometry); astronomical unit, light-year, parsec, square mile, decibel, degree from measurement. Nothing removed as fiction (brands like Barbie, Game Boy, Tamagotchi, Monopoly kept as real products). Viagra in accidental inventions now adult=1. 'Leaning Tower' in famous experiments kept as is (no standard name for Galileo's drop experiment that is short). Martin Luther King left without 'Jr.'.
